title: Kamishiro Rui — Sentimental Snapshot〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Oh, Kamishiro! Morning!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, good morning.
Hayashi, Taniyama, morning to you two as well.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Hey. Oh, Kamishiro, have you been sleeping okay since the school trip?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me? Yes, rather well since I felt very tired when I got home...

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
Right?
Miyake here said he felt lonely and couldn't sleep at all.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Th-That's because we were all in the same room and played cards and had pillow fights and stuff together... My mind was ready for more, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Those two nights were very fun.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: A pair of kings! No one's gonna top that...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I can. A pair of aces.
That's it for me.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
You're the president, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
No...!
You didn't cheat, did you?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
What's the big idea, Kamishiro...?
Those landed right on top of us...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Yeah, what he said!
We're fighting for Tenma now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I thought we were supposed to fight as individuals. Three versus one seems a bit unfair, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No matter...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miyake, you're my last hope.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Huh?!
What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of it made for good memories. Including having to write letters of apology.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Hey, that's the spirit...!
The Weirdo Wombo Combo knows what's up!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Should you really be praising them for that?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Haha... Oh, also! Kamishiro, you bought a ton of souvenirs. Did you give them to your family already...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, quite a few friends and acquaintances as well.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
You bought that weird mutsuhashi too.
Were those also a gift?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, the grapefruit-flavored mutsuhashi gummies? Yes, they were. I'm looking forward to hearing how they taste.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I bought some of those too. My family actually kind of enjoyed them.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Did you have any?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Uhh... N-No, because everyone else liked them so much. I felt bad eating them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? It's unusual for someone to buy their family a snack they haven't actually tried.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Hey, cut me some slack.
What about you, Kamishiro? Did you try them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
What?!
Then, quit pulling my chain!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Miyake, Taniyama & Hayashi
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!
Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That trip really was way too much fun...

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Yeah, I actually didn't think I'd enjoy it all that much.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Same... The ones I went on in elementary school and junior high were also really fun... But this was hands down the best.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Especially since I didn't have that many friends in junior high. Even when I was with my group, I felt like I was all alone.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean... I had friends, but they were all in different classes...

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: It is pretty rare to be put in a class with people you get on with like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This school trip also ended up being the most fun for me.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Actually, Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: We're still gonna be friends moving forward, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you for inviting me into your group.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Haha. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: We're happy to have you.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Let's keep having tons of fun together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
